mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden upward crossing of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.0% triggers a bearish reaction in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market concerns about labor market weakening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger does not occur as defined.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns in the interaction model (p > 0.05) over the 60-day horizon when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by CPIAUCSL inflation below 2.0%, sustained monetary easing (rising FEDFUNDS) reduces policy uncertainty and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid upward crossing of employment levels (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million in a single month signals a strong labor market, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger does not occur as defined.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding supply conditions, boosting demand and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-year rolling Rank IC remains below 0.03 or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime characterized by rising GDP (GDPC1) and persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), market confidence in economic growth and stability drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: regime: post-recession recovery with GDPC1 rising and FEDFUNDS <1.0%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL inflation (below 2.0%) signals coordinated monetary easing and controlled inflation, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns in the interaction model (p > 0.05) over the 60-day horizon when both proxies rise.
